ours: Message body text is 0x222222 (`TG_TEXT_PRIMARY`, TGTheme.m:223, used via `primaryTextColour` at TGChatViewController.m:5449).

ours: Service (action) messages use system 12 on a 21 pt plate with corner radius 10.5, row height 30 (TGChatViewController.m:5085-5108, height at :4946-4947).

ours: Maximum bubble width is `kBubbleMaxW + 2 * kPadH` = 260 pt for every message, with no reduction for outgoing messages or for group avatars (TGChatViewController.m:51, :5391).
theirs: Layout max width is 250 pt total including paddings, reduced by 40 when avatars are shown on an incoming message and by a further 12 for outgoing messages (so 238 outgoing, 210 incoming-with-avatar).

ours: The message table leaves `scrollsToTop` at its default YES, so tapping the status bar jumps to the oldest loaded message (no `scrollsToTop` assignment for `self.table` anywhere in TGChatViewController.m).
theirs: The conversation table sets `scrollsToTop = false` and installs a 1 pt off-screen `_scrollToTopInterceptor` scroll view that owns the status-bar tap; `scrollViewShouldScrollToTop:` instead scrolls the table to the BOTTOM (`contentSize.height - 28`) and returns false.
fix: Set `self.table.scrollsToTop = NO` and add a 1x1 interceptor scroll view with `scrollsToTop = YES` whose `scrollViewShouldScrollToTop:` scrolls the table to the newest message and returns NO.

ours: The group sender avatar is a plain UIImageView with no gesture recogniser (TGChatViewController.m:1091-1096), so tapping a participant's avatar in a group does nothing.

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:487-497 and :1062-1067 — sortByName defaults to NO, so the list is sorted by statusRank (last seen) and rebuildSections returns nil, giving one flat section with no A-Z headers.

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:1661-1690 — the 'Invite Friends' row is a TGContactRowCell: 51pt tall (kContactRowHeight, :1604-1606), 40pt avatar image, system 19 title in accentColour, no disclosure arrow.

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:1570-1581 — extra rows are injected into section 0 as rows 0..n, so they sit underneath the first letter's section header.

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:1570-1574 — only one action row ('Invite Friends'), plus our own 'My Invite Link'.

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:1653-1655 — sectionIndexTitlesForTableView returns the letters, so the A-Z index strip is drawn down the right edge of the main Contacts list.

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:1134-1146 — no address-book-denied state at all; the only overlay is a centred grey label.

Then select ON for Telegram.' with 'ON' bold; the nav-bar add button is hidden while it shows.

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:1236-1238 — a 'Sort' custom left bar button opening a 'Sort by / Last Seen / Name' action sheet (:499-515).

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:1199-1211 — the table background view is listBackgroundColour, so rubber-banding above the search bar shows the list colour.

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:1190-1197 — a stock UISearchBar with barTintColor / tintColor set by hand.

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:1241-1259 — a 58pt table footer with an invented two-line 'N contacts synced from your address book' label.

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:1713-1725 — first and last name are one attributed string joined by a literal space, in a single UILabel that truncates the whole string.

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:1683 and :1768 — avatar corner radius = kContactAvatar * 0.12f = 4.8pt.
theirs: The 'avatar40' image processor rounds a 40x40 avatar with a corner radius of exactly 4.

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:1134-1146 — centred labels reading 'Loading...', 'No results' and 'You have no contacts yet'.
theirs: The contacts list has no empty or loading placeholder text; it shows the action rows over an empty white table, and the only overlay state is the phonebook-access-denied one.
citation: TGContactsController.mm:495-509 and :664-712 (no empty/loading label anywhere in loadView or the table delegate)

ours: src/TGContactsViewController.m:1222-1234 — the add button is a custom UIButton with a '+' drawn as a boldSystemFontOfSize:18 UILabel.
theirs: The add button is a TGToolbarButton whose image is AddIcon.png (AddIcon_Landscape.png in landscape) with minWidth 35.

ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:172,310-338 — the list is a hardcoded 22-country fallback, replaced later by an async TDLib getCountries request. Offline or before the response lands the user sees 22 rows and ~12 index letters.
theirs: The full 234-entry country list ships in the bundle as a plain text resource and is parsed synchronously on first access; no network involved, the list is always complete and immediate.
fix: Copy PhoneCountries.txt into the bundle resources and parse it with the original's `code;id;Name` loop as the primary data source (dispatch_once, cached). Keep getCountries only as an optional refresh, never as the source that makes the difference between 22 and 234 rows.

ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:409-433 — search filters the same table in place: sections collapse to one, the section index disappears instantly, the navigation bar stays visible, and a UISearchBar system Cancel button is toggled (419-425).
theirs: Search runs through TGSearchDisplayMixin: a second UITableView is created and overlaid, the main table gets scrollEnabled = false, the section index view is faded out over 0.15s, and the navigation bar is hidden for the duration of the search.
fix: On search activation: animate the index view alpha to 0 over 0.15s, set tableView.scrollEnabled = NO, and hide the navigation bar animated; reverse on deactivation. Show results in an overlay table rather than mutating the main table's section structure.

ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:125-131,133-135 — no left bar button item at all; the screen relies on the default navigation back button.
theirs: A TGToolbarButton titled Common.Cancel is installed as leftBarButtonItem, built from the stretchable HeaderButton_Login art (leftCapWidth 11) with white text, shadow UIColorRGBA(0x07080a, 0.35f) and minWidth 59.
fix: Add a left bar button using images/HeaderButton_Login@2x.png and HeaderButton_Login_Pressed@2x.png (both already present in images/, currently unused here), stretchableImageWithLeftCapWidth:11 topCapHeight:0, title "Cancel", white text, shadow colour 0x07080a at 0.35 alpha, minimum width 59.

ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:163-170,300-308 — an invented "No results" empty state: bold system 15, colour 0x8e8e93, centred vertically over the whole view.
theirs: No empty state exists anywhere on this screen. When the query matches nothing the search results table is simply empty; when the query is cleared the results table is hidden outright.
citation: Telegraph/Telegraph/TGLoginCountriesController.m:473-507 (searchMixin:hasChangedSearchQuery: ends with setSearchResultsTableViewHidden:searchQuery.length == 0 — no empty-state view is ever built)
fix: Delete _emptyLabel, updateEmptyState and its viewDidLayoutSubviews positioning; leave the results table blank on no match.

ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:374-407 with TGCountrySearchTokens (79-110) — matches against diacritic-folded tokens of the name, plus the initials abbreviation, plus the ISO code, plus the dial code, and requires every query token to prefix-match some token.
theirs: Match is prefix-only against the lowercased country name, or against any space-separated word of it; the query is additionally transliterated to Latin and stripped of combining marks. Neither ISO code nor dial code nor initials are searchable, so typing "380" or "ua" finds nothing.
fix: Reduce matching to: lowercase query, plus a CFStringTransform kCFStringTransformToLatin + StripCombiningMarks variant; accept a row if the lowercased name, or any of its space-separated words, hasPrefix either form. Drop the ISO, dial-code and initials tokens.

ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m — no orientation overrides, so the picker rotates with the device.
theirs: The controller is locked to portrait: shouldAutorotateToInterfaceOrientation returns portrait only, shouldAutorotate returns false, supportedInterfaceOrientations is portrait mask.
fix: Add the same three overrides returning portrait-only / false / UIInterfaceOrientationMaskPortrait.

ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:213-216,335-337,340-356 — sorting uses localizedCaseInsensitiveCompare and sections are cut from the already-sorted flat array by first letter.
theirs: Sections are keyed by the first character of the name and sorted with compare:options:NSDiacriticInsensitiveSearch | NSWidthInsensitiveSearch | NSForcedOrderingSearch; items inside a section are sorted with the same option mask.
fix: Replace both comparators with [name1 compare:name2 options:NSDiacriticInsensitiveSearch | NSWidthInsensitiveSearch | NSForcedOrderingSearch] so accented names (Åland, Côte d'Ivoire, Curaçao) land in the same section and order the original produced.

ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:248-295 (styleSearchInputField:) — the placeholder colour is left at the UIKit default grey, and the field's font is forced to systemFontOfSize:14.
theirs: The placeholder colour is explicitly set to UIColorRGB(0x8d9298) via TGHacks; the field's font is never overridden.
fix: Set the placeholder colour to 0x8d9298 (via the same private-ivar hack already used elsewhere in the project) and remove the field.font = systemFontOfSize:14 assignment so the search field keeps UIKit's default metrics.

ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:258-264 — the SearchInputField background is inserted at index 0 and positioned at y = 0.5 unconditionally.
theirs: The background image view is added on top (addSubview:) and offset by 0.5 only on retina; on non-retina it sits at y = 0. The clear-button glyph is also nudged by setTextFieldClearOffset:0.5 on retina.
fix: Guard the 0.5 offset behind a retina check and apply the matching 0.5 clear-button offset on retina, mirroring TGIsRetina() in the original.

ours: src/TGCountryPickerViewController.m:153 — searchBar.placeholder = @"Search".
theirs: The login countries screen creates its TGSearchBar without ever assigning a placeholder, so the field starts empty apart from the magnifier icon.
fix: Drop the placeholder assignment on this screen, or verify against the 2013 screenshots before keeping it — the original's search field on this controller carried no placeholder text.

ours: Chat rows show no date/time at all; the whole row width from x=73 to width-10 is given to title and preview (src/TGForwardPicker.m:121-122).
theirs: Every dialog row draws a right-aligned date label at x = width - dateWidth - 9, y = 9, height 15, font systemFontOfSize:13 (bold for the text form), colour 0x337acc, and the title width is clamped to dateFrame.origin.x - 4 - 73 - 18.
citation: TelegraphKit/TelegraphKit/TGDialogListCell.m:1305-1312 (dateY=9, dateFrame, titleLabelWidth) and :391-394 (dateFont 13, dateTextFont bold 13, textColor 0x337acc)
fix: Add a right-aligned date label to TGForwardPickerCell for the non-compact (chat) style: frame (w - dateWidth - 9, 9, dateWidth, 15), font [UIFont boldSystemFontOfSize:13], colour rgb(0x33,0x7a,0xcc), white when highlighted; shrink the title frame to (73, 6, dateX - 4 - 73 - 18, 20).

ours: Chat preview is one 20pt-tall line at y=29 (src/TGForwardPicker.m:122), so a long last message truncates after one line.
theirs: The dialog list message rect is CGRectMake(73, 29, width-73-10, 40) — 40pt tall, i.e. two lines of the 14pt text font, drawn with NSLineBreakByTruncatingTail.
fix: In the non-compact branch of -layoutSubviews set _preview.frame = CGRectMake(73, 29, w - 73 - 10, 40) and _preview.numberOfLines = 2 with lineBreakMode NSLineBreakByTruncatingTail.

ours: The Contacts tab is a single flat alphabetically sorted section with no headers and no index bar (src/TGForwardPicker.m:244-266, numberOfRowsInSection returns one flat array).
theirs: The contacts list is split into per-letter sections with a 25pt header per lettered section and a live A–Z section index down the right edge (sectionIndexTitlesForTableView / sectionForSectionIndexTitle, whose first entry scrolls to the search bar).
fix: Group self.contacts into sections keyed by the uppercased first letter of the sort name, implement numberOfSectionsInTableView / titleForHeader via the original's section container view, return 25 from heightForHeaderInSection for lettered sections, and return the letters from sectionIndexTitlesForTableView (index 0 scrolling to contentOffset -contentInset.top).

ours: The contact row subtitle is the @username, or failing that the phone number (src/TGForwardPicker.m:608-617).
theirs: The contact subtitle is the user's presence string — "online" / "last seen ..." — coloured 0x0779d0 when online and UIColorRGBA(0, 0.53) otherwise; usernames and phone numbers never appear as the subtitle.
fix: Set cell.preview.text from the user's status (online / last seen), colour it rgb(0x07,0x79,0xd0) when online and [UIColor colorWithWhite:0 alpha:0.53] otherwise; drop the @username/phone fallback.

ours: The search bar is a stock UISearchBar tinted with barTintColor = listBackgroundColour, or tg_setTintColor white 0.68 on iOS 6 (src/TGForwardPicker.m:175-182).
theirs: The list's search bar is a TGSearchBar whose backgroundImage is SearchBarBackground.png, with the dialogListSearchIcon set into a cleared input field and the stripe hidden; placeholder DialogList.SearchLabel = "Search".
fix: images/SearchBarBackground@2x.png is already in the repo and is used this way by TGChatListViewController.m:1416. Apply [self.searchBar setBackgroundImage:[UIImage imageNamed:@"SearchBarBackground.png"]] (guarded by respondsToSelector) instead of the barTintColor/tintColor path.

ours: The empty state is a single centred 15pt secondary-colour label pinned at y=120 with invented strings "No chats" / "No contacts" / "Loading..." / "No results" (src/TGForwardPicker.m:188-196, 310-320).

citation: TelegraphKit/TelegraphKit/TGDialogListController.mm:884-916 (container 250 wide, icon, bold 15 title, 14 body, 0x8b97a5, gaps 21 and 8) and Telegraph/Telegraph/en.lproj/Localizable.strings:227-228

Note images/ has no NoMessages.png yet — it must be copied from the original bundle before the icon can be used.

ours: Row labels keep their dark text while the row is pressed — the labels have no highlightedTextColor and only the selectedBackgroundView plate changes (src/TGForwardPicker.m:44-60, 86-87).
theirs: On highlight the dialog cell fills the title, message and author text with pure white, and the contact cell draws its title white and its subtitle in highlightedTextColor 0xffffff.
citation: TelegraphKit/TelegraphKit/TGDialogListCell.m:195 and :249-252 (highlightedColor = white, used when _highlighted), Telegraph/Telegraph/TGContactCell.m:348 (highlightedTextColor 0xffffff), TGContactCellContents.m:80

ours: Contact rows put the title at x=49 and the subtitle at x=50 (src/TGForwardPicker.m:107, 118-119).
theirs: The contact cell computes avatarWidth = 5 + 40 = 45 and lays the title at avatarWidth + 9 = 54, the subtitle at avatarWidth + 9 + 1 = 55; the right edge is width - 5.

ours: Group chats in the Chats tab are rendered exactly like private chats — no icon before the title (src/TGForwardPicker.m:121).
theirs: A group conversation draws DialogListGroupChatIcon.png at the title origin offset (0, 4) and reserves 21pt, shifting the title right to 73 + 21 and reducing its width by the same amount (highlighted variant on press).
citation: TelegraphKit/TelegraphKit/TGDialogListCell.m:227-247 (DialogListGroupChatIcon.png drawn at (0,4)) and :1317-1321 (groupChatIconWidth = 21, titleRect x = 73 + groupChatIconWidth)

ours: Contact names render in a single plain [UIFont systemFontOfSize:19] label for the whole "First Last" string (src/TGForwardPicker.m:74, 584).
theirs: The contact cell draws two runs at 19pt — titleFont systemFontOfSize:19 and titleBoldFont boldSystemFontOfSize:19 — with boldMode 2, i.e. the first name regular and the last name bold, separated by a 4pt gap.
citation: Telegraph/Telegraph/TGContactCell.m:332-333 (titleFont/titleBoldFont 19) and :337 (_boldMode = 2); TGContactCellContents.m:67-86 (first run regular, second run bold, +4 gap)

ours: cellForRowAtIndexPath overrides the cell's own colours with the theme's, giving title 0x222222 and preview 0x8D8E90 (src/TGForwardPicker.m:600-601; TGTheme.m:223-224).

ours: The table's backgroundView is a flat listBackgroundColour view, so over-scrolling past the top of either list exposes plain white (src/TGForwardPicker.m:184-197).

fix: Add a subview to the table at CGRectMake(0, -500, width, 500) with backgroundColor rgb(0xe4,0xe9,0xf0) and flexible width, matching the chat list.

ours: The 44pt toolbar is added to self.navigationController.view in -viewWillAppear: and removed in -viewWillDisappear:, so it floats above the whole navigation stack and pops in/out on every transition (src/TGForwardPicker.m:519-533).

citation: Telegraph/Telegraph/TGForwardTargetController.m:154-170 (toolbar added to self.view in loadView) and :197 (parentInsets bottom = toolbar height)

ours: One search bar and one query string are shared by both tabs, so text typed while on Chats still filters after switching to Contacts (src/TGForwardPicker.m:292-308, 509-517).
theirs: Chats and Contacts are two separate child view controllers, each with its own TGSearchBar and its own search mixin state; switching tabs swaps controllers and leaves each list's search untouched.
citation: Telegraph/Telegraph/TGForwardTargetController.m:230-242 (setCurrentViewController swaps _dialogListController / _contactsController); TGContactsController.mm:516-539 and TGDialogListController.mm:499-525 (each builds its own search bar)
fix: Keep per-mode query state (two NSStrings) and restore the search bar text and scroll position when -groupButtonPressed: changes mode, rather than carrying one shared query across both lists.

ours: A subtitle-less row centres a fixed 24pt (compact) / 20pt (chat) title box in the row (src/TGForwardPicker.m:113-116).

ours: TGIcons.m:41 — `UIFont *font = bold ? [UIFont boldSystemFontOfSize:12] : [UIFont systemFontOfSize:12];`. 35 call sites, and the common ones ("More", "Edit", "New", "Cancel", "Reload", "Chat", "Try Again") pass bold:NO, so most nav-bar buttons render in regular weight.
theirs: Every toolbar button label, of every type, is `[UIFont boldSystemFontOfSize:12]`. There is no regular-weight variant in the class.

fix: Drop the `bold:` branch in TGIcons.m:41 — always `[UIFont boldSystemFontOfSize:12]`. Keep the `bold:` parameter for source compatibility but ignore it for the font (see the Done-plate finding for what it should actually select).

ours: TGIcons.m:801 and :895 — avatar corner radius is `side * 0.12f`, i.e. 6.7pt on a 56pt list avatar and 4.8pt on a 40pt one.

The only per-row glyphs that exist are the four `ListIcon*` pairs (Invite, Friends, Encrypted, Block) on the contacts list.

ours: The phone field shows raw digits as typed and the navigation title stays "Your Phone" forever (src/TGLoginViewController.m:106, 336, 1634-1637 — only a 15-digit cap, no formatting).

citation: TGLoginPhoneController.m:491-552 (formatting in shouldChangeCharactersInRange) and TGLoginPhoneController.m:646-662 (updateTitleText, falls back to Login.PhoneTitle only when empty)

ours: The registration ("Your Info") step is two full-width 290pt LoginInput plates separated by a 6pt gap (43 tall at top, next at +49), fields inset 12pt, text boldSystemFontOfSize:18, and no avatar control at all. src/TGLoginViewController.m:520-543.

ours: Code step notice reads "We have sent you an SMS with the code" (src/TGLoginViewController.m:846).
theirs: "We've sent an SMS with an activation code to your phone. Please enter the code below."
fix: Set self.noticeLabel.text to "We've sent an SMS with an activation code to your phone. Please enter the code below." in -showCodeStepWithPhoneNumber: (keep the server 'description' override that follows).

ours: Next is disabled and dimmed to 0.6 alpha until the input passes a length check; tapping it with an empty field does nothing but re-focus (src/TGLoginViewController.m:708-712, 736-740).
theirs: Next is always enabled. Pressing it with an empty phone or a code shorter than 2 chars shakes the phone field, the input plate and the country-code field (four 0.05s autoreversing 4pt horizontal steps) and moves first responder to whichever field is empty.
citation: TGLoginPhoneController.m:705-735 (shakeView) and :742-752 (nextButtonPressed); same shake in TGLoginCodeController.m:420-467
fix: Keep the Next button enabled at full alpha at all times, and in -actionButtonTapped when [self hasSubmittableInput] is false run the original shake (dx +4/-4, duration 0.05, UIViewAnimationOptionAutoreverse then repeat count 3) on inputField, inputBackgroundView and countryCodeField before focusing the empty field.

ours: The code step shows "You can request the code again in m:ss" and then a "Send the code again" plate button (src/TGLoginViewController.m:1542-1551, 378-390).
theirs: Three crossfading labels and no button: "Telegram will call you in %d:%.2d" counting down from exactly 1 minute, fading (0.2s, 0.1s delay) into "Requesting a call from Telegram..." when it hits zero, then into "Telegram dialed your number" when the call request succeeds. All three are systemFontOfSize:14, colour 0xc4c9d2, shadow 0x25272b offset (0,1), positioned at inputBackground.bottom + 14.
fix: Replace the countdown wording with "Telegram will call you in %d:%.2d" and add the two follow-up states ("Requesting a call from Telegram...", "Telegram dialed your number") as 0.2s crossfades at the same y; if the resend button must stay for modern code types, hide it while the countdown is running instead of showing both.

ours: Country button falls back to "Country" at full 0xf0f0f0 opacity when the dial code matches nothing (src/TGLoginViewController.m:444, 461).
theirs: Two distinct strings, both dimmed: "Country Code" when the field holds only "+", "Invalid Country Code" when digits are present but unknown — and the title colour drops to UIColorRGBA(0xf0f0f0, 0.7f) in both cases, returning to solid 0xf0f0f0 on a match.
fix: In -updateCountryNameForDialCode set the title to "Country Code" when countryCodeField.text.length <= 1 and "Invalid Country Code" otherwise, and setTitleColor tgRGBA(0xf0f0f0, 0.7f) for those two cases, restoring tgRGB(0xf0f0f0) when a country is matched.

ours: Tapping anywhere on the phone input plate focuses the phone field (src/TGLoginViewController.m:660-662).
theirs: The tap location decides: a hit left of the country-code field's right edge focuses the country-code field, anything else focuses the phone field.
fix: Change -inputBackgroundTapped to take the UITapGestureRecognizer, and when [recognizer locationInView:inputBackgroundView].x < countryCodeField.frame.origin.x + countryCodeField.frame.size.width (converted into plate coordinates) focus countryCodeField, else inputField.

ours: The country picker is pushed onto the login navigation stack (src/TGLoginViewController.m:482-483).

fix: Wrap TGCountryPickerViewController in a UINavigationController whose bar carries the same LoginHeader.png background and present it with -presentViewController:animated:completion:, dismissing it from the onPick block.

ours: Phone placeholder is "Phone number"; registration placeholders are "First Name" / "Last Name" (src/TGLoginViewController.m:336, 356, 965).
theirs: "Your phone number", "First name", "Last name" (sentence case).
fix: Set inputField.placeholder = @"Your phone number" on the phone step, @"First name" on the registration step, and lastNameField.placeholder = @"Last name".

ours: No placeholder colour or font is set on any field, so iOS draws its default 70% grey at the field's own font (src/TGLoginViewController.m:333-343, 353-364).
theirs: Every login placeholder is explicitly styled: phone field placeholder systemFontOfSize:17 in 0x999999; code field placeholder systemFontOfSize:18 in 0xadb0b6; first/last name placeholders in 0x999da4.
fix: Add a placeholder-styling helper (attributedPlaceholder on iOS 6) and apply systemFontOfSize:17 / 0x999999 to the phone field, systemFontOfSize:18 / 0xadb0b6 to the code field, and 0x999da4 to the two name fields.

ours: While a request is in flight only the Next button swaps to a spinner; the rest of the screen stays live and tappable (src/TGLoginViewController.m:664-671).
theirs: The phone controller also unhides a full-bounds shadeView that covers the whole view for the duration of the request, blocking the country button and the fields.
fix: Add a full-bounds UIView with FlexibleWidth|FlexibleHeight added last in setupUI, hidden by default, and unhide it in -setBusy: while busy.

ours: Backspacing at the start of the phone field does nothing (plain UITextField, src/TGLoginViewController.m:333).
theirs: The phone field is a TGBackspaceTextField; a backspace on an already-empty field moves first responder back to the country-code field.
fix: Subclass UITextField overriding -deleteBackward to notify the controller when the field is empty, and in that callback call [self.countryCodeField becomeFirstResponder].

ours: Numeric code entry accepts up to 8 digits and auto-submits at 5 or more (src/TGLoginViewController.m:717-720, 1626).
theirs: The code field is hard-capped at 5 characters and submits automatically the moment the 5th digit lands.

ours: The registration step shows a notice label "Enter your name so your friends know who is writing to them." 16pt above the plates (src/TGLoginViewController.m:961, 545-549), and allows 64-character names (line 1619).

ours: Viewer chrome is two flat CG rectangles: _topBar 44pt tall at y=0 with colorWithWhite:0 alpha:0.6, _bottomBar 60pt tall, and the status bar is hidden on appear (src/TGMediaViewController.m:657-658, 687-690, 766).

ours: TGTabBar.m:117-176 - tap only commits on touchesEnded; touchesBegan sets a pending index and touchesMoved/touchesCancelled can revert to _touchStartIndex, so the delegate (and the actual tab switch) fires on lift.

ours: RootViewController.m:69-72 - customTabBar.hidden is flipped when a child navigation controller pushes, so the bar disappears/reappears abruptly mid push animation.

citation: TGAppDelegate.mm:303 ([TGNavigationController navigationControllerWithRootController:_mainTabsController]) plus the absence of any hidden= on _customTabBar in TGMainTabsController.m:353-365
fix: Push detail controllers on the outer navigation controller (self.navigationController of RootViewController) instead of per-tab UINavigationControllers, and remove the -navigationController:willShowViewController: hidden toggle at RootViewController.m:69-72.

ours: RootViewController.m:30-42 wraps each tab in its own UINavigationController, so each tab carries its own nav bar and title, and switching tabs cross-fades two different bars.

fix: Adopt the original structure: children conform to a TGTabControllerChild-style protocol (controllerTitle, controllerTitleView:, controllerLeft/RightBarButtonItem, navigationBarShouldBeHidden) and RootViewController writes them onto its own navigationItem on selection, with the 0.1s kCAMediaTimingFunctionEaseIn CATransition on the title layer.

ours: RootViewController.m:21-25 - the TGHacks layout delegate is installed on self.view only.

fix: In RootViewController -loadView also call [TGHacks setLayoutDelegateForContainerView:self.view.subviews[0] layoutDelegate:<a second TGTabsContainerViewDelegate instance>] (guarding for a non-empty subviews array), retaining it like self.layoutDelegate.

ours: TGTabBar.m:97-115 - setSelectedIndex only calls setNeedsLayout, so the white selection PNG moves on the next layout pass rather than at the moment of the touch.

fix: In TGTabBar -setSelectedIndex: compute indicatorWidth/paddingLeft/additionalWidth/additionalOffset and set self.selectedView.frame = CGRectMake(paddingLeft + indicatorWidth*_selectedIndex + additionalOffset, 0, indicatorWidth + additionalWidth, 49) directly, in addition to (or instead of) setNeedsLayout.

ours: The menu closes only on touch-up (TGPopupMenu.m:556-563, TGActionsMenu.m:645-652) and only if the touch lands outside CGRectInset(_card.frame, -4, -12) - so a tap in a 4pt horizontal / 12pt vertical dead halo around the card does nothing at all, and a touch that starts outside and drags never dismisses.
theirs: Dismissal is a hitTest on the container: any touch that reaches the container itself (i.e. anywhere not on a menu button) hides the menu immediately at touch-down, with no dead zone. It also swallows that touch by returning nil.
fix: Replace -touchesEnded: in both files with -hitTest:withEvent:: call super, and if the result is self or nil, call externalDismiss and return nil. Drop the CGRectInset(-4,-12) halo entirely.
